title: 7.5 Put on your coat
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Tell someone to put on or take off clothes (Put on your gloves. / Take off your boots.) and say what someone is doing with them (She's putting on her coat.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.5 Clothes for the Weather: A1 says which clothes the weather needs (It is cold. I need a coat.); A1+ 7.5 puts them on and takes them off. The one new grammar relationship is the two-word verbs put on and take off, as a request (Put on your gloves. / Take off your boots.) and with A1+ 3.3's -ing (She's putting on her coat. / He's taking off his jacket.). Four new photos show the cast mid-way, with the weather that explains it in the photo; 7.2's Why…? Because… and 7.4's It's snowing./It's raining. give the reason.
prerequisite: A1 7.5 coat, gloves, boots; A1 7.3 jacket and hat; A1+ 3.3 he's/she's + -ing; A1+ 7.2 Why…? Because…; A1+ 7.4 It's raining./It's snowing.
speaking_outcome: Join the two words and stress the second (put-ON, take-OFF; PUT-ting-ON, TAY-king-OFF). Do not require native-like speed.
